source: Mitutoyo America, 'Check Points for Measuring Instruments: Digimatic Outside Micrometer' (YouTube nESHNdtUI5A), 720p, downloaded through downr.org to C:\jigged-data\footage\ and analysed locally with MediaPipe Hand Landmarker; the video is not in the repo
method: trainual's motion/extract_hands.py, then its analyze_timing.py segmenting restricted to the windows where hands work the micrometer; the video is edited, so only uncut shots give durations

observed.what: Both hands on the micrometer: the right at the thimble and ratchet, the left holding the frame.
The faces cleaned on a slip of paper, in one uncut wide shot: about 6 s.
Measuring: both hands again, the right turning at the thimble end, the left on the frame.
The micrometer in a stand: the right hand at the thimble, and from 80 s the left at the anvil end, so both hands stay busy.

used_for: micrometer-measure-thickness: the two-handed hold, and #3, the cleaning, 6 s
the thimble is turned by the fingers while the hand barely rolls: knuckle-line twist median 6-9 deg/s in the turning shots
